messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: geom_smooth and logistic regression bands
parts:
Hello;
Please consider the code below and the attached figue. I am trying to calculate upper and lower intervals using
glm but for some reason can't match geom_smooth. Any pointers will be appreciated.

data(mtcars)
dat <- subset(mtcars, select=c(mpg, am, vs))
dat

logr_vm <- glm(vs ~ mpg, data=dat, family=binomial)

predd <- cbind(dat,predict(logr_vm,dat,type="response",se.fit=T));head(predd)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(predd, aes(x=mpg, y=vs)) + geom_point() + 
  stat_smooth(method="glm", family="binomial") +
  geom_line(aes(y=fit),data=predd,colour="red",linetype=2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=fit + (1.96*se.fit))) +   geom_line(aes(y=fit - (1.96*se.fit)))

messages.author: 2710b717e5dbb066
messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth and logistic regression bands
parts:
The standard error and confidence interval should be done on the
linear scale, not the response scale (you can see that your interval
includes values grater than 1 which are impossible).

Try this:

data(mtcars)
dat <- subset(mtcars, select=c(mpg, am, vs))
dat

logr_vm <- glm(vs ~ mpg, data=dat, family=binomial)
